fields.label: Testimonials
fields.name: ltt_dive_in_testimonials_items
fields.instructions: Add between one and ten testimonials. With two or more, visitors browse them one at a time with arrow and dot controls.

sub_fields.label: Quote
sub_fields.name: quote
sub_fields.instructions: Enter the quote without quotation marks; they are added automatically.

sub_fields.label: Photo
sub_fields.name: photo
sub_fields.instructions: Optional square portrait, shown as a small circle. The photo is decorative because the person’s name appears directly below it.

sub_fields.label: Role or location
sub_fields.name: role
sub_fields.instructions: Optional, for example a job title and town.
